related_questions.question: Is it normal for COVID to last 5 days?
related_questions.snippet: How Long Does COVID Last? COVID-19 lasts anywhere from a few days to a few weeks. Once symptoms (if you have them) clear up, it usually means that COVID-19 isn't in your body anymore. Some people may develop long COVID — a wide range of symptoms that last weeks, months, or years after COVID-19 illness.

related_questions.question: Is COVID still contagious after 5 days?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, COVID-19 can still be contagious after 5 days. People with COVID-19 can be infectious from 1-2 days before symptoms start and up to 8-10 days after symptoms begin, according to the CDC. While the majority of transmission occurs during the first 5 days, it's still possible to transmit the virus after that period.
